resources.string: When you open the keyboard right after taking a screenshot, it shows up as a suggestion and a copy is kept in the keyboard\'s clipboard history (deletable from 📋). Needs the Photos permission; only the Screenshots folder is read and nothing leaves the phone.
Partial photo access: choose “Allow all” so new screenshots can be detected.
Photos permission denied. Turn it on in Settings › Apps › Aurebesh Keyboard › Permissions.
